name: docs-configuration-cli-md-00
yaml:
version: '3.8'
services:
  rift:
    image: zainalpour/rift-proxy:latest
    ports:
      - "2525:2525"
      - "4545:4545"
      - "9090:9090"
    environment:
      - MB_PORT=2525
      - MB_ALLOW_INJECTION=true
      - RUST_LOG=info
    volumes:
      - ./imposters.json:/imposters.json
    command: ["--configfile", "/imposters.json"]
